content:
Hi, I’m Michał I’m a Senior Unity Developer and Tech Lead with 10+ years of experience shipping games and interactive applications across PC, console, mobile, and XR. I hold the Unity Certified Expert Programmer credential and have spent the last several years leading teams and owning architecture on production-scale projects — most recently as Tech Lead on a live MMO with 50+ engineers. I care about scalable systems, clean code, and shipping things that actually work.
Projects Live MMO Gameplay UI — The Sandbox Tech Lead for the gameplay UI layer of a live MMO. Designed scalable input, state, and navigation architecture used across the entire game by a team of 50+ engineers. Translated complex game design requirements into robust, extensible runtime systems built with Unity UI Toolkit.
